THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / OCTOBER 2026
KNITWEAR & LAYERS
115
STUDY 117
Purple Velvet Top & Leg Warmers
Rights check
Source: 25007.jpg
Playful, vintage, grunge-inspired
WORKING NOTES
- The velvet top and patterned leg warmers are the textures
to keep.
- Add 'full-length, head to toe' to keep the boots in frame.
Try this: Use head-to-toe framing to include the boots.
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long,
wavy honey-blonde hair stands
full-length against a black backdrop with
her arms crossed. She wears a fitted
purple velvet long-sleeve top, layered
silver chains with a round pendant, and
a patterned mini skirt with a sage
waistband. Purple knit leg warmers and
lace-up ankle boots complete the look. A
patterned scarf hangs from one side.
Her expression is calm and direct. Soft,
focused studio light. Palette of orchid,
sage, and deep black. Playful and
vintage, in the style of a 1990s grunge
lookbook.
